title: The Meeting Time That Works for Nobody
title_ja: 国際交流で公平な時間を探す
fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: Four schools in different countries plan an online discussion about the protection of rivers and local water resources.
sentences.ja: 異なる四か国の学校が川と地域の水資源の保護についてオンライン討論を計画します。

sentences.en: The organizer chooses a convenient time for students at the host school without consulting the other teachers.
sentences.ja: 主催者は他校の教師に相談せず、主催校の生徒に都合のよい時間を選びます。

sentences.en: However, this hour falls late at night for one school and during a long journey home for another.
sentences.ja: しかしその時刻はある学校には深夜で、別の学校には長い帰宅途中に当たります。

sentences.en: An international invitation does not always create a realistic opportunity for the invited students to participate.
sentences.ja: 国際的な招待をしても、招かれた生徒に現実的な参加機会が必ず生まれるわけではありません。

sentences.en: Several participants also share their family's digital devices or have limited spaces where they can join quietly.
sentences.ja: 家族とデジタル端末を共有したり、静かに参加できる場所が限られたりする参加者もいます。

sentences.en: The group discovers that meaningful inclusion requires understanding other people's circumstances before a meeting begins.
sentences.ja: グループは意味ある包摂には会議前に相手の事情を理解する必要があると気づきます。

sentences.en: Each teacher explains local school schedules, available devices, and the strength of the internet connection.
sentences.ja: 各教師は現地の日程、使用可能な端末、インターネット接続の状況を説明します。

sentences.en: For example, one school has a reliable network but only one classroom large enough for the entire group.
sentences.ja: 例えばある学校は安定した回線があるものの、全員が入る教室は一つだけです。

sentences.en: Another school can join from home, but some students must share their devices with younger family members.
sentences.ja: 別の学校では自宅から参加できますが、年下の家族と端末を共有する生徒もいます。

sentences.en: The organizers learn that internet speed alone cannot describe every barrier to a successful exchange.
sentences.ja: 主催者は回線速度だけでは交流の障壁をすべて示せないと学びます。

sentences.en: Students also need time to prepare questions and a practical way to understand their partners' explanations.
sentences.ja: 生徒には質問の準備時間や相手の説明を理解する実際的な方法も必要です。

sentences.en: Good planning therefore requires listening to participants instead of assuming that one arrangement suits everyone.
sentences.ja: よい計画では一つの方法が全員に合うと決めつけず、参加者の声を聞くことが必要です。

sentences.en: The schools agree to hold two shorter sessions rather than require every participant to join one long discussion.
sentences.ja: 学校は全員に一度の長時間討論を求める代わりに、短い二回の会議を開くことにします。

sentences.en: In addition, teams prepare short recorded introductions for classmates who cannot attend the live meeting.
sentences.ja: さらにライブに参加できない仲間のため各チームは短い録画自己紹介を準備します。

sentences.en: Questions are shared before the event so learners can organize ideas and practice unfamiliar English expressions.
sentences.ja: 学習者が考えを整理し不慣れな英語表現を練習できるよう質問は事前に共有します。

sentences.en: A recorded message allows students to control their pace, while live discussions support spontaneous questions.
sentences.ja: 録画なら進める速さを調整しやすく、ライブ討論では即興の質問ができます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, neither method can completely replace the benefits of the other in every situation.
sentences.ja: それでもどちらの方法もすべての状況で他方の利点を完全には代替できません。

sentences.en: The organizers try to balance interaction with access instead of treating one technology as a universal answer.
sentences.ja: 主催者は一つの技術を万能と考えず、交流と参加しやすさの両立を目指します。

sentences.en: After the event, students describe which activities helped them contribute and which created difficulties.
sentences.ja: 活動後、生徒はどの活動が貢献を助け、どの活動が困難を生んだか説明します。

sentences.en: Some preferred speaking live, while others felt more confident after preparing written questions in advance.
sentences.ja: ライブで話すことを好む人も、事前に書面で質問を準備して自信を持てた人もいました。

sentences.en: The teachers examine this feedback and decide what to improve before organizing another international meeting.
sentences.ja: 教師は意見を検討し、次の国際会議を開く前の改善点を決めます。

sentences.en: They recognize that a high attendance rate does not necessarily mean everyone had an equal chance to speak.
sentences.ja: 参加率が高くても全員に同等の発言機会があったとは限らないと認識します。

sentences.en: A successful global classroom does more than connect computers across national borders.
sentences.ja: 成功するグローバルな教室は国境を越えてコンピューターをつなぐだけではありません。

sentences.en: It creates ways for learners with different circumstances to communicate meaningfully and learn together.
sentences.ja: 異なる事情の学習者が意味ある対話をし、共に学べる方法を作ります。

questions.prompt: What is the author's main message?
options: International online learning requires fair opportunities to participate, not simply an invitation.
Every country should follow the host school's timetable.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加の公平性が主題です。

questions.prompt: Why is the original meeting time unsuitable?
options: The host school has no devices.
It is late at night or conflicts with travel for some students.
questions.explanation_ja: 時差や現地日程の問題です。

questions.prompt: Why is an invitation not enough?
options: All partners are fluent in English.
Practical barriers may still keep learners from joining.
questions.explanation_ja: 招待と実際の参加可能性は異なるためです。

questions.prompt: What does one school have despite its reliable network?
options: Only one classroom large enough for everyone.
questions.explanation_ja: 教室が一つだけとあります。

questions.prompt: What is a limitation of internet speed as a measure?
options: It cannot show every barrier to meaningful participation.
questions.explanation_ja: 速度だけでは参加しやすさを測れません。

questions.prompt: Why are questions shared before the event?
options: To allow learners to prepare their ideas and English.
questions.explanation_ja: 事前準備の機会を作るためです。
spontaneousは即興的・自発的です。

options: Two shorter sessions and recorded introductions.
questions.explanation_ja: 短い会議と録画の組み合わせです。

questions.prompt: Why are attendance rates not sufficient?
options: Numbers alone do not show whether everyone could contribute equally.
All students speak the same amount.
Every meeting has the same outcomes.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加人数と参加の質は異なります。

questions.prompt: Why does the passage end with meaningful communication?
options: To define success by inclusion and learning instead of technology alone.
To suggest teachers should never plan events.
questions.explanation_ja: 技術接続を超えた学びの価値を結論づけます。
